title: Optimal drift optimizer for non-convex optimization
summary: We study a finite-horizon stochastic control criterion for non-convex optimization in which Brownian exploration is balanced against a quadratic control cost. Rather than emphasizing the classical Hopf--Cole representation, we isolate the exact drift selected by the criterion and reorganize it in a form adapted to optimization. The key object is the conditional terminal law of the optimal process.
